features: Unchanged baseline team features, exact same games and cutoff rules
selection: Lowest 2023 three-class log loss; exact ties choose larger alpha
scaling: StandardScaler fitted only within each training fold; final fit uses 2015-2022
errorDistribution: Zero-mean Gaussian; sigma is RMS of expanding-season out-of-fold errors on 2017-2022, each fitted only on earlier seasons. One sigma per alpha, minimum 1 point. No validation/test residuals used.
probabilities: Discretize latent Gaussian margin into integer bins with half-point boundaries. Home win >=1, tie=0, away win <=-1. For a supplied home handicap, cover means margin+handicap>0; push means equality.
role: Offline experiment only; separate prospective registration required before live shadow issuance
limitations: Gaussian errors ignore football key-number spikes, skew and changing variance
Tie and push probabilities may be poorly calibrated
Historical source availability still assumes a 48-hour lag
No sportsbook odds, CLV, or profitability evaluation
